name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Bluesight's mission, getting the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, resonates with me personally. I've spent roughly eight years navigating the healthcare system myself as a patient, fighting insurers for approvals on physical therapy and imaging, so I understand firsthand what it costs when the right care doesn't reach the right person on schedule. Professionally, a meaningful share of the partner book I managed at Birdeye were agencies serving healthcare clients, real B2B exposure to how healthcare organizations buy and adopt technology.

I bring 15 years of customer success and account management experience: at Birdeye, I managed a reseller partner book and retained 94% of it by staying close to customer health metrics and intervening on adoption gaps before they became churn. At Accelo, I built trusted advisor relationships directly with C-suite executives, guiding onboarding and escalating risk early enough to resolve it before it threatened the relationship. I want to be direct about one gap: I haven't worked inside a healthcare company specifically, or managed SaaS contracts above the $100K range this role's ideal candidate profile describes, my account sizes have run smaller. What I bring instead is a consistent retention and adoption track record and real motivation to be in this space.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience and motivation map to what Bluesight needs from this role. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
